hypotheses.claim: Traversal.preload must start a foreign nav worker/router or wait for native readiness
hypotheses.evidence: Frozen Traversal.preload is void Navigator.start(), unawaited. Host binds NavWorld at profile/template construction before isolate Start. ScriptWalkArm already refuses when world is None.

hypotheses.claim: A void no-op is faithful to already-performed native nav preparation
hypotheses.evidence: Panel/TUI/host-play/legacy Play all load NavWorld before script_start_load. Foreign start() also returns immediately without awaiting ready.

hypotheses.claim: Preload should throw when nav is unbound
hypotheses.evidence: Foreign start() does not throw. Unbound behavior is walk-arm false. Throwing not impl is the current defect even when nav is bound.

hypotheses.claim: bestPickaxe/bestAxe/AXES should copy foreign Tools.ts tables
hypotheses.evidence: Brief forbids cloning foreign policy. Selected content owns use (pickaxe_checker mining param) and wield (opheld2 Attack). Foreign AXES omits black axe; native woodcut checker includes it.

hypotheses.claim: Existing tools.js AXES id0 and ignored-skill/callback fallback are sufficient
hypotheses.evidence: Bronze-first AXES inverts Gnome gearHasSteelOrBetter. bestAxe inventory fallback violates bank-only available(). bestPickaxe/canWieldTool throw.

hypotheses.claim: A held steel tool can be wielded on these seeds
hypotheses.evidence: Coal Attack 1 / gnome Attack 1. opheld2 steel_axe/steel_pickaxe require Attack 5. Use from pack is legal.

hypotheses.claim: axes.obj param=levelrequire is woodcutting use or Attack wield
hypotheses.evidence: woodcutting_axe_checker has no WC gate. Wield is tier*.rs2 Attack 5/20/30/40, not obj params 6/21/31/41. Pickaxe obj param IS mining use (steel 6).

hypotheses.claim: First failures are missing loc-chop/mine opcodes or catalog regression
hypotheses.evidence: Both catalogs byte-identical on these scripts. Loc.interact already exists and never ran. Failures are preload and bestPickaxe not impl.
